component.name: Kin Galeri
component.summary: Fast local photo & video library for Linux

description.p: Kin Galeri is a local-first photo and video library for the Linux desktop, built with Qt 6, Qt Quick and C++20.

It indexes folders on disk into a searchable catalog with EXIF metadata and a thumbnail cache, so browsing a large collection stays fast. Photos and videos are never modified unless you explicitly ask; removing something sends it to a recycle bin inside the library.

ul.li: Recursive folder indexing with selectable ignore rules
Timeline grid, full-screen viewer and playback via libmpv
Full-text search over file names, albums and camera metadata
Manual and source-based albums, favourites and soft-delete recycle bin
Light/dark themes, six accent colours and English/Indonesian UI
No account, no server and no mandatory network access

description.p: Opening a file from a file manager now enters that file's folder album before showing it, so previous/next stay inside the same album instead of walking the whole library.

Fixes "Open with": files passed by a file manager now open in the viewer instead of dropping the user on the grid. The details sheet can be reopened after it is closed with Escape or a click outside, the sidebar keeps only navigation, and scanning can recognise images and videos by content for ambiguous extensions such as .ts, with the list of ambiguous extensions editable in Settings.

Fixes the generated benchmark rows. They exist to measure a large library, but the only button that added them lived in the empty view, so it wrote 50,000 synthetic entries into a real library and there was then no way to take them back out. Settings has a "Remove generated rows" action, the command line has --clear-benchmark, and adding them asks for confirmation first.
First public release: indexing, thumbnails, timeline grid, viewer, video playback, albums, recycle bin, search and settings.
